description: Mandatory milestone tracking via update_activity tool
applyTo: "**/*"

# Milestone Tracking

Use the integration activity tool when a concrete milestone is reached:

- `sdk_setup`: an SDK package was installed and setup succeeded.
- `auth_configured`: runtime credentials were configured and referenced.
- `first_call_made`: an API call was implemented and executed.
- `error_encountered`: a reported integration error is being diagnosed.
- `error_resolved`: a confirmed API-call failure was fixed.

Do not record searches, plans, or milestones that have not actually occurred.
